verdict.rationale: The patent filing path documents a credential-account identity wall ('You'll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up'), which suggests remote, self-service sign-in. Online filing and email or post alternatives also mean no in-person visit is documented. Nothing confirms the sign-in uses MFA or explicitly rules out biometric liveness or a mailed PIN. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that One Login uses credential MFA (e.g., authenticator app or SMS) completable remotely, a statement that no biometric liveness or postal PIN step is required, and evidence the trade mark path uses the same sign-in.
